package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
)

const (
	onboardingEnsureBodyLimit int64 = 1 << 10
	onboardingActionBodyLimit int64 = 4 << 10
)

type teacherOnboardingEnsurer interface {
	Ensure(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, error)
}
type teacherOnboardingActionApplier interface {
	ApplyAction(context.Context, string, domain.AssistantUIActionRequest) (domain.AssistantUIActionResult, error)
}

type TeacherOnboardingHandler struct {
	Ensurer teacherOnboardingEnsurer
	Actions teacherOnboardingActionApplier
}

func (handler TeacherOnboardingHandler) Ensure(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		Schema string `json:"schema"`
	}
	if decodeOnboardingJSON(w, r, onboardingEnsureBodyLimit, &request) != nil || request.Schema != domain.TeacherOnboardingEnsureSchema {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid onboarding ensure request")
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Ensurer.Ensure(r.Context(), studentID)
	writeOnboardingResult(w, result, err)
}

func (handler TeacherOnboardingHandler) ApplyAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	var request domain.AssistantUIActionRequest
	if decodeOnboardingJSON(w, r, onboardingActionBodyLimit, &request) != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid assistant UI action")
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Actions.ApplyAction(r.Context(), studentID, request)
	writeOnboardingResult(w, result, err)
}

func decodeOnboardingJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, limit int64, target any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, limit))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("request body must contain one JSON object")
	}
	return nil
}
func writeOnboardingResult(w http.ResponseWriter, result any, err error) {
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding):
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid teacher onboarding request")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "historical_session_unavailable")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "teacher onboarding state conflict")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDialogStateUnavailable):
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "teacher onboarding unavailable")
	default:
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "teacher onboarding failed")
	}
}
